tex: \proof Let $X= I_{20}$ and $\mathcal{G} = \{\{i,i+10\}: 0\leq i \leq 9\}$. We construct a $\mathrm{GDD}(3,4, 20)$ of type $2^{10}$ on $X$ with group set $\mathcal{G}$. Let $\mathcal{H}$ be a permutation group generated by the following permutation:
Our $\mathrm{GDD}(3,4,20)$ $(X,\mathcal{G},\mathcal{B})$ admits the automorphism group $\mathcal{H}$ and the base blocks are listed as follows:
\begin{tabular}{l l l l l l l l }

For any $x\in G$, $G\in \mathcal{G}$, we can check that the derived design at the point $x$ of the $\mathrm{GDD}$ is an $\mathrm{RGDD}(2,3, 18)$ of type $2^{9}$ with group set $\mathcal{G}\setminus \{G\}$. We only need to list the resolutions of the derived designs at $0$ and $10$ to prove; the blocks in each row form a $\mathrm{PC}$ of $X\setminus \{0,10\}$.
\begin{tabular}{l l l l l l l l }

expansion.sigma: sigma(x) = (x + 1) mod 10 for x < 10, 10 + (x - 9) mod 10 for x >= 10
expansion.blocks: sigma^k(B) for k = 0..9 and the 24 base blocks; points sorted in each block, blocks sorted
expansion.POINT x: PC j at x = sigma^x(printed row j of B0) for x = 0..9, sigma^(x-10)(printed row j of B10) for x = 10..19
expansion.triples: points sorted within each triple; triples of a class in printed order

notes: No printed line or class is ambiguous in the pinned text: every data line is consumed completely by {...} items of 4 (base blocks) or 3 (derived triples) points (asserted), so the LaTeX source did not have to decide any case; text and TeX give identical ordered lists.
Each printed row is one class: LF 1047 states that the blocks in each row form a PC of X \ {0, 10} (6 triples per row; 8 rows for B0 and 8 rows for B10).
I20 is read as {0, ..., 19}: the group set {{i, i + 10} : 0 <= i <= 9}, the generator (0 ... 9)(10 ... 19) and every printed point (asserted < 20) agree with this reading.

pdftotext flattens superscripts in the anchored sentences: 'type 210' (LF 1031) and 'type 29' (LF 1046) stand for type 2^10 and type 2^9. Page furniture: LF 1030 (page number 17) with a form feed opening LF 1031; no data line is affected.
Printed class order is kept: PC j at x is the image of printed row j of B0 (x = 0..9) or of B10 (x = 10..19).
